exposure: Criteria-based audit (CBA) for obstructed labor and fetal distress
cohort: 27,960 parturients at a tertiary referral hospital in Tanzania
finding: Implementing a criteria-based audit (CBA) for obstructed labor and fetal distress effectively reduced perinatal morbidity and mortality while also increasing the cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: The CBA led to a decrease in cesarean delivery rates for referred term multiparas with induced labor or prelabor cesarean delivery, but an increase in cesarean delivery rates for both referred and non-referred preterm pregnancies.
